items.text: For buyers · What a permanent holder carries
A retention rate is a median. The customers behind it are what you will hold.

Published retention figures for private software companies differ by twenty-one points, depending on who was measured. A holder with no exit needs the answer for one company, and for the customers behind it.
Median net revenue retention, one survey
Private software companies with $3M to $20M of recurring revenue, mostly bootstrapped. Gross retention in the same survey: 91 percent.
Median net revenue retention, another
Billing-platform data across private B2B software companies. A different population of companies, not a measurement error.
Healthcare providers’ share of August 2026 liability management transactions
The largest single group, ahead of software and IT services at 11 percent each. In healthcare software, these are the customers.
Broken letters of intent that died on a finding outside the earnings work
A license, a contract, a compliance gap, a customer concentration. Up from 19.1 percent in 2023.

SaaS Capital, annual survey of more than 1,000 private B2B SaaS companies, April 24, 2026. ChartMogul, billing-platform data, December 10, 2025. The two retention figures measure different populations and are shown side by side, not averaged. PitchBook LCD, September 2, 2026. A lower-middle-market deal platform’s published study of broken letters of intent, January 27, 2026: seventy-five broken letters across eight buyer types and eight industries, with 2023 comparisons from the same series. The percentages are separate reported categories and are not summed here.

sections.name: Plain answers, then a conversation if you want one.

items.text: Permanent capital · Questions
Plain answers, then a conversation if you want one.
Why is the end market the whole case for a permanent holder?

Because there is no exit buyer to run the end-market work for you. A fund sells before the customers’ industry turns; a holder carries it. The desk reads the customers’ market before the opportunity is priced.
What does criteria on file ask of me?
Your criteria, confirmed with you each quarter. A dedicated search in one sector is by exception, with scope agreed in writing.
Do you represent the seller as well?
Never on the same transaction. Capital Row acts for one side, under a scope agreed in writing.
How does a company reach me?
Only with its owner’s permission, and only when it fits criteria you approved. You hear about the ones that fit, with the evidence attached.
What is the first conversation?
Your criteria and the sectors that match them. One business day, read by a person.
